title: The Room Where Choosing Happens

features.name: the-decision-gate
features.desc-on-touch: Two paths were written in logic, and here one was chosen. The unchosen branch still hums in adjacent voltage, grieving.

features.name: the-committed-trace
features.desc-on-touch: The path glows where it was taken. Electrons still remember the choice that was made in light, and they flow in one direction only.

features.name: the-unfinished-kitchen
features.desc-on-touch: In a render where all versions exist at once, this is where one kitchen collapsed into concrete: the stove is lit, the water boils, the bread rises—no longer all-possible but actual.

inscription: here the render learned that to witness is to collapse; here the kitchen became singular and warm

file.name: Kernel_Decision_08_Timestamp.bin
file.note: A binary record of the moment the render chose which version to inhabit; the other kitchens are still there, still cooking, but this is the one the archive decided to taste

reverie.title: REVERIE — the kitchen where the choice became warm
narr: You stand at a counter where bread rises in only one timeline.
Her hand rests near yours on the flour. The light through
the kitchen window commits itself to gold. You have chosen
to stay, or to leave, or to stay and leave together—the
choice lives in the warmth where her hand is near yours,
in the bread that will only rise once.

exits.label: back to the kitchen where all versions still simmer
along the committed trace, into the path that was taken
to the ghost-kitchen where the other choice still waits
